# pOS common-styling

> Design system for platformOS apps: native CSS (`pos-` classes, `--pos-` tokens, `@layer common-styling`), Liquid partials and vanilla JS — no React, no Tailwind. Light, dark and high-contrast themes are token overrides. Build UI only from the classes, partials and tokens listed in the files below.

Start with AGENTS.md, then ds-index.json. Paths are relative to this repository; in an app that installed the module the same files live under modules/common-styling/.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to build UI with this DS — read order, layout setup, hard rules, color pairings, component list, patterns
- [ds-index.json](modules/common-styling/public/assets/tokens/ds-index.json): every component with its classes, render call, constraints; name aliases; layout and color rules
- [token-map.json](modules/common-styling/public/assets/tokens/token-map.json): every token — CSS name, Figma name, light / dark / high-contrast value, description
- [MIGRATION.md](MIGRATION.md): 1.x → 2.0.0 migration (incl. the palette change) and deprecated names
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): what changed, newest first

## Component specs

One JSON per component (modules/common-styling/public/assets/tokens/components/): usageExample, props, do / dont, accessibility, tokens per variant and state.

- `alert-card` (AlertCard): [alert-card.json](modules/common-styling/public/assets/tokens/components/alert-card.json)
- `avatar` (Avatar): [avatar.json](modules/common-styling/public/assets/tokens/components/avatar.json)

- `breadcrumb` (Breadcrumb): [breadcrumb.json](modules/common-styling/public/assets/tokens/components/breadcrumb.json)
- `button` (Button): [button.json](modules/common-styling/public/assets/tokens/components/button.json)

## Tokens and styles

- [pos-primitives.css](modules/common-styling/public/assets/style/pos-primitives.css): raw palette and sizes — never use these directly in UI
- [pos-config.css](modules/common-styling/public/assets/style/pos-config.css): semantic tokens and the light / dark / high-contrast theme blocks
- [pos-themes.css](modules/common-styling/public/assets/style/pos-themes.css): the 15 built-in themes — Default (no class) plus 14 `pos-brand-<key>` classes (Wireframe also needs `pos-style-wireframe`), generated from `tokens/themes.json`
- [icon-registry.json](modules/common-styling/public/assets/tokens/icon-registry.json): every icon's logical name and purpose (`icon.liquid` is generated from it), rendered with render 'modules/common-styling/icon', icon: 'name'
